pages.title: Preview and Adjust
pages.text: Interact with the Hair Styling Table, choose a hairstyle, and preview your character. Adjust color and helmet display behavior, or load a skin reference for the preview.$(br2)A reference skin assists matching and previewing; editing a draft does not immediately replace your equipped appearance.

pages.title: Apply Your Appearance
pages.text: Confirm and save to apply the hairstyle and color to your hair slot. Save frequently used colors for later.$(br2)With Chinese selected, the styling table buttons, color choices, hints, and skin-loading status appear in Chinese.
